decision: Separate detail reads from mutation samples
why: Repeated writes grow audit payloads and invalidate equal-data comparisons
result: v2 reads PERF-1 and writes PERF-50

decision: Use a task-owned PostgreSQL 17 instance on port 55479
why: Shared preview Postgres on 55439 disappeared during measurement; isolate runtime ownership

decision: Omit SSE and error diagnostic headers; correct fixture and UI attribution
why: Cross-family review identified incomplete stream counters, weak fixture identity and request-completion attribution

decision: Verify MCP acknowledgement separately from webpage visibility
why: Transport success does not prove remote refresh behavior
result: local MCP 200; opened page still stale after 30 seconds

decision: Reject a hosted rerun that encountered 401
why: A token captured once expired mid-run; unauthorized responses are not business samples
result: reload normal app session; read current same-user token per request; no automatic mutation retry

decision: Record isolated hosted batch and 20 local browser round trips
why: Keep slow tail results rather than choosing the faster exploratory batch
result: 60 hosted business requests; 40 UI transitions; local and hosted MCP observations
